name: Tokushima

flag.description: A yellow emblem on a blue field: the hiragana とく (toku) drawn as a bird in flight.
flag.symbolism: とく is the first part of Tokushima, shaped as a bird for unity and soaring growth.

hook: Tokushima's yellow bird on blue spells とく (toku); Tottori's bird on blue is white.
trivia: The Awa Odori dance festival draws over a million visitors every August.
The Naruto whirlpools churn in the strait between Tokushima and Awaji Island.
